newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares end mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares end mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Three stocks rose, three fell and one was flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday.
Turnover was 1.3 million zlotys, down from Thursday's 1.9 million zlotys.
NFI units fell 1.4 percent to 137 zlotys in a turnover of 15.2 million zlotys.
The continuous trading system, which lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks fell and the main market's index eased 0.3 percent.
